name: OWASP Mobile Top 10
source_notes: IDs and names verified from index.md and risk pages in a clone of OWASP/www-project-mobile-top-10 (last commit 2025-10-09).
caveats: Risk pages live under a 2023-risks/ folder but this is the 2024 final release; do not label it 2023. No exact publication day was found.
IDs M1..M10 collide with the 2016 list (e.g. 2016 M2 was Insecure Data Storage); qualify them with the edition (e.g. OWASP-MOBILE-2024:M5).
M7 is "Insufficient Binary Protections" on the index but "Insufficient Binary Protection" on its risk page.
All MASVS/MASWE links are inferred; OWASP publishes no MASWE/MASVS-to-Top-10 mapping.
M7 prevention was not captured in the notes.
Candidates not on the 2024 list: Data Leakage, Hardcoded Secrets, Insecure Access Control, Path Overwrite and Path Traversal, Unprotected Endpoints, Unsafe Sharing.
Maturity 'lab' comes from the OWASP project catalog (level 3; label inferred).

items.name: Improper Credential Usage
items.summary: Credentials or API keys are hardcoded or user credentials are mishandled, letting attackers impersonate users or abuse backend services.
prevention: Never hardcode credentials or API keys in app code or configuration files.
Transmit user credentials securely and do not store them on the device.
Use revocable tokens instead of long-lived credentials.

static: API keys or secret literals in Swift string constants or Info.plist
EXPO_PUBLIC_* / NEXT_PUBLIC_* / VITE_* variables named like SECRET, PRIVATE, SERVICE_ROLE or a non-publishable KEY
Raw key literals passed to SecKeyCreateWithData, CCCrypt or CryptoKit init(rawRepresentation:)
React Native AsyncStorage.setItem(...) storing tokens or credentials

items.name: Inadequate Supply Chain Security
items.summary: Compromised or vulnerable third-party libraries, SDKs or build/distribution steps introduce weaknesses into the app.
prevention: Apply secure coding and code review across the supply chain.
Secure app signing and distribution.
Use only trusted, validated third-party libraries and control their updates.
Monitor dependencies for issues.

static: Podfile.lock / Package.resolved / JS lockfile dependencies with known vulnerabilities
Missing lockfile for the mobile project
review: Vetting of third-party SDKs and build pipeline integrity

items.name: Insecure Authentication/Authorization
items.summary: Weak authentication or authorization (e.g. client-side-only checks or offline auth without the server) lets attackers bypass identity or access controls.
prevention: Avoid weak patterns such as client-only authentication or authorization.
Enforce authentication and authorization on the server.
Do not perform offline authentication without server verification.

static: Role/permission checks only in client code guarding sensitive actions
URL scheme / universal link handlers that trigger sensitive actions without validation
review: Server-side enforcement of authorization for every API

items.name: Insufficient Input/Output Validation
items.summary: Untrusted input or output is not validated or encoded, enabling injection, XSS in WebViews, path traversal and similar attacks.
prevention: Strictly validate input and enforce length limits.
Encode and sanitize output (e.g. against XSS).
Apply context-specific validation against path traversal and injection.
Check data integrity.

static: Deep link / universal link handlers using URL parameters (amounts, paths, HTML) without validation
WKUserContentController.add(_:name:) JS bridges exposing native functionality
WebView loading attacker-controllable URLs

items.name: Insecure Communication
items.summary: Data in transit is exposed because TLS is missing, weakened or certificate validation is bypassed.
prevention: Assume the network is hostile.
Apply TLS to all transport channels, including third-party SDK traffic.
Avoid mixed secure/insecure sessions.
Validate certificates properly and pin where possible.

static: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads / NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent / NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsForMedia / NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads in Info.plist
NSExceptionMinimumTLSVersion below TLSv1.2 or NSExceptionRequiresForwardSecrecy = false
Hardcoded http:// API URLs
URLSession challenge handlers calling .useCredential without SecTrustEvaluateWithError
No NSPinnedDomains for developer-controlled endpoints
review: Traffic outside the URL Loading System (Network.framework/CFNetwork) is not governed by ATS

items.name: Inadequate Privacy Controls
items.summary: Personal data is collected, used, shared or retained beyond what is needed, or without consent and transparency.
prevention: Minimize the amount and variety of PII collected.
Prefer coarse over fine data (e.g. coarse location) and reduce collection frequency.
Anonymize or blur data where possible and delete it after expiry.
Obtain user consent for optional processing.

static: Missing PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy or required-reason APIs not declared in NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes
Known tracking domains not declared in NSPrivacyTrackingDomains
Over-broad permissions, entitlements or inaccurate purpose strings
PII written to logs or the general pasteboard
review: Whether collected data matches the declared purpose and privacy policy

items.name: Insufficient Binary Protections
items.summary: App binaries can be reverse engineered or tampered with, exposing hardcoded secrets, logic or enabling repackaging.

static: Hardcoded sensitive data (keys, secrets) recoverable from the binary
review: Need for obfuscation, anti-tampering and integrity checks given the app's threat model

items.name: Security Misconfiguration
items.summary: Insecure defaults or settings (permissions, cleartext traffic, exported components, backups) weaken the app.
prevention: Use secure default settings and remove default credentials.
Avoid world-readable/writable files and request least-privilege permissions.
Disallow cleartext traffic and pin certificates when possible.
Disable backups (Android) and limit exported components.

static: ATS exceptions allowing cleartext in Info.plist
Unjustified permissions or entitlements

items.name: Insecure Data Storage
items.summary: Sensitive data stored on the device is unprotected and can be read by other apps, backups or attackers with device access.
prevention: Encrypt sensitive data at rest with strong algorithms.
Use platform secure storage such as Keychain (iOS) or Keystore (Android).
Apply input validation and secure session management.
Keep dependencies patched.

static: UserDefaults / @AppStorage storing tokens, passwords or API keys
React Native AsyncStorage storing tokens or secrets
print / NSLog / os_log with sensitive values
Sensitive files not excluded from backup
UIPasteboard.general writes of sensitive data

items.name: Insufficient Cryptography
items.summary: Weak algorithms, short keys, poor randomness or bad key management undermine confidentiality and integrity.
prevention: Use strong, current algorithms (e.g. AES, RSA, ECC).
Avoid deprecated or weak algorithms.
Use sufficient key lengths.
Manage keys securely.

static: CC_MD5 / CC_SHA1 / Insecure.MD5 / Insecure.SHA1
rand() / random() / drand48 in security contexts
Hardcoded cryptographic keys
